svg.aria-label: Roof plan of the Zero Mile Hall, the Mall and concourses A and B: one continuous roof with north-light coffers, branching tree columns, gardens in the valleys, jaali screens on the sun-facing walls, an oculus over the Zero Mile marker and a 40 m cantilever over the stepwell forecourt.
svg.text: OCULUS over the Zero Mile marker
the three gateway axes meet here
THE ROOF · ONE SURFACE OVER THE HALL, THE MALL AND PIERS A AND B
Roof plan. Structure from Mumbai, underside and gardens from Bengaluru, edges from Ahmedabad.
Jaali screens on the sun-facing walls
the stepwell forecourt in the west valley.
the garden valley where the Hall
becomes the Mall; courts at pier roots.
Hall 45→24 m · Mall 26–33 m · piers 27→20 m
7 in the valleys · 1 garden valley · 24 courts
96 m across, over the Zero Mile marker
40 m over the kerb and forecourt
S to Bengaluru, WSW to Mumbai, WNW to Ahmedabad, each within
8°. The three axes meet under the oculus.
Coffers face north: daylight without direct sun, under a
thick, insulated shell built for 47 °C afternoons.
